components.local_changes: Initial deterministic engine, CPU contract, scheduler, host-neutral XRGB8888 framebuffer value types and caller-owned block-media contract
Host-independent address-space bus with an optional observer for deterministic external traces
Host-allocated RAM and ROM regions with endian-neutral bus transactions
Independent floppy-drive geometry, change state and raw-sector access over the host-neutral block-media contract

Replaced global CPU state and legacy memory coupling with explicit state and bus transactions; added tested arithmetic and logical operations including ADC/SBB in both ModR/M directions and immediate groups, byte/word multiply, unsigned byte/word divide with interrupt-zero faults, NEG, CBW, accumulator TEST and XLAT; added conditional flow, ModR/M memory operands, explicit ES/CS/SS/DS overrides, stack operations, direct and indirect near/far calls and jumps, near/far return forms with caller cleanup, SAHF/LAHF, NEC V30 TEST1/CLR1/SET1/NOT1 bit operations, software and callback-based real-mode interrupts, complete D0-D3 rotate/shift groups, general byte/word XCHG, flag-control operations, byte and word string operations including CMPS with REP/REPE/REPNE, ROM-checksum and memory-check paths, prefix-aware instruction tracing and full basic-register inspection to the still-incomplete V30 subset

Replaced global devices and direct CPU coupling with opaque single-instance components: an 8237 programming and request-state core with synchronous device-facing memory transfers, external XT page latches with explicit channel mapping and effective addresses, and a single edge-triggered 8259A whose request inputs must remain asserted until acknowledgement

Reworked the inherited uPD765-compatible command path into an opaque AT-register component with explicit drives, IRQ6 callback, DMA channel 2 transfers and raw-sector media; removed global drive tables, host files, UI state and real-time timers; declared and enforced a 4096-byte maximum sector payload before DMA or media access; reject terminal count before a complete sector instead of reporting a partial DMA read as success, while allowing terminal count after a complete sector to finish a command before an extended EOT

Reduced the inherited parallel subsystem to an opaque caller-owned SPP register component with explicit output and ACK-interrupt callbacks; removed global port tables, host character devices, EPP/ECP, DMA, timers and threads

Reduced the inherited UART model to an opaque NS16450 register core with divisor latch, interrupt priority, modem/data loopback and explicit host callbacks; removed 16550 FIFOs, global COM tables, mouse coupling, host serial backends and real-time baud scheduling

Ported the measured 8253 edge-state core behind an opaque bus component, removing legacy globals, host timers and platform callbacks while retaining modes 0-5, BCD, gates, latches and output transitions

Ported the PCS 86 B0h-B7h control window and E0h-EFh counter/alarm RAM to an opaque, deterministic component with BCD calendar progression, IRQ generation, checksum repair and caller-owned persistence

Isolated the PVGA1A register files, Paradise extension lock, DAC state and 256 KiB planar VRAM behind generic memory and I/O buses; added deterministic text-mode geometry and XRGB8888 rasterization from the programmed character, attribute, font and palette state. Graphics modes, scan timing, cursor and blink phase remain absent, and input-status timing is an explicit deterministic bring-up approximation

Opaque session lifecycle, typed machine factory, machine reset and inspection hooks, optional host-neutral framebuffer discovery/rendering operations and normalized physical-key input events independent of guest scan-code sets
Deterministic host adapter for tests and headless use

Frontend-neutral machine adapter registry, declarative asset requirements and typed configuration preparation over caller-owned blobs and block media; optional file helpers remain separate from the adapter contract
Qt6 application shell generated from frontend adapter metadata, with scaled XRGB8888 display, normalized keyboard input and explicit session lifecycle controls

Registry-driven command-line frontend independent of Qt, with host-side firmware loading, read-only file-backed block media, deterministic execution reporting and framebuffer capture; consumes the shared frontend adapter contract without direct machine-system dependencies

Isolated the documented V30, RAM, ROM, DMA, PIC, scheduler-driven PIT and MM58167, PVGA1A core and motherboard register map behind a typed machine factory; added explicit reset, inspection, interrupt routing, rational clock accumulation, NMI/open-bus behavior, diagnostic and memory-control latches, selector-only EMS, unpopulated-option-ROM open bus, video-arbitration latches, runtime framebuffer publication, gated SPP and NS16450 devices, dual board keyboard/mouse protocol queues, normalized Set 1 keyboard delivery and a configured uPD765-compatible controller with IRQ6, DMA2, active-low disk change and PCS 86 floppy jumpers. The EMS aperture, mouse input and cycle-accurate timing remain absent
